Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Rowan-Sage.title: Rowan Sage
Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Rowan-Sage.content:
Player: Taylor (she/her)
Name: (Theresa) Rowan Sage
Species:  Succubus
Class:  Paladin -
Pronouns:  (She/they)
Description:
Theresa was born the only child of a poor but deeply religious family in a small, intensely religious town. Desperate to ease her family’s suffering, she spent long nights in prayer, begging for a miracle that would bring them wealth and security. One night, something answered. Believing she was receiving divine help, Theresa unknowingly made a pact with a fiend. The “blessing” transformed her into a succubus, and when her new nature was revealed, her family and community cast her out in fear and shame.
Alone and terrified of what she had become, Theresa refused to accept that her fate was to be a monster. Clinging to the faith and values she was raised with, she sought a path that would let her prove her goodness through action. She took up the oath of a paladin and swore the Oath of Redemption, dedicating herself to protecting others, showing mercy whenever possible, and resisting the darker instincts of her infernal nature.
Now Theresa travels as a quiet vigilante, saving those in danger and seeking to bring light where she can. Willingly joining the war because every good deed is a step toward the one thing she wants most; to return home and prove to her family that she is still their daughter. Beneath her calm compassion lies a deep fear of abandonment and a desperate need to be seen not as a demon, but as someone worthy of love and forgiveness.

Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Silky.title: Silky
Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Silky.content:
Player: Graham (he/him)
Name: Silky (Mervin) Bitterbottom
Species:  Gnome
Class: Warlock -
Pronouns: (He/him)
Description:
After the unjust execution of his parents by the magistrate, Mofongo, of the Woodlands, Mervin Bitterbottom, a young gnome, was orphaned and destitute, left with only his wits and a simple wooden engraving of his parents faces and names.
After many years sleeping in stables, sheds, and haylofts, Mervin had grown older, but not much taller nor wiser. He found a permanent shelter in the attic crawlspace of the Woodland library, accessible only to beings one-quarter the size of typical Woodland beings. He lived there rent-free, unknown to anyone in the Woodlands. Alas, he had a space to call home and free books to read, but it was space enough for only one, and he missed his parents dearly. 
To keep himself fed and clothed, Mervin frequented the corner tavern every day to pilfer hard-earned coin from the regulars. He would run card games, shuffle shells, and tell long, expansive tales. Mervin was part of the atmosphere and entertainment for the regulars. The barkeep didn’t mind because Mervin wasn’t actually proficient at duping anyone sober. He frequently lost his bets, or his epic stories would unwind under scrutiny, and so he wasn’t taken very seriously. He was teased about his name, and the regulars poked fun at his height, goading the tavern dogs to chase him around the tavern like he was a dog toy.
One night, while walking the aisles of the Woodland library after an unsuccessful day at the tavern, Mervin came across a particularly ancient-looking light blue book located on a Gnome-height shelf in the “enchanted objects” section. This book had frayed pages, gold-plated edges, a buckle, and was particularly dusty. No other books in the library looked like it, as they were elven - pristine but with drab green and brown hues. 
Mervin stole the unique book back to his crawlspace where he cracked open the buckle and rifled through the delicate pages. He landed on a page-sized image of a spiral circle. Intrigued, Mervin traced the spiral lines with his finger not once, not twice, but three times and…poof! Out leapt a small, light blue genie with the same color and gold accent.
The genie had been living within the pages of the book for hundreds of years and was quite lonely. The genie told Mervin that he had many powers. Namely, that he could inhabit inanimate objects and feel the emotion that they represent and that he could bestow special powers upon beings. And so, Mervin saw an opportunity for a deal to be made. Mervin would allow the genie to enchant the wooden engraving of his parents, finally feeling the love of others. And the genie would bestow special powers of social persuasion upon Mervin, in hopes that he could earn recompense from Mofongo for the deaths of his parents. 
After the deal was struck, Mervin’s confidence ballooned, and he quickly outgrew his usual tavern tricks, swindling more adept (read: sober) targets. He successfully convinced the shopkeeper, the cobbler, and the haberdasher to each part ways with their finest clothing and accessory articles. Mervin’s reputation grew, and he was adorned with the nickname “Silky” due to his deft tongue, convincing storytelling, and polished regalia. He preferred this name over Mervin, and so he began introducing himself as such as his reputation grew. Silky could sell water to a fish. Don’t worry, he’ll tell you about it sometime…
With his tail feathers upright and his chest puffed outwards, Silky’s ambition for retribution against the Mofongo also grew. He contrived a detailed plan to convince not only Mofongo himself, but all the commoners in the Woodlands that it was indeed he, Silky, and not the Mofongo, who was rightfully and legally the Woodland magistrate due to the unjust killing of his parents. 
His logic was impenetrable, his storytelling was illustrative and convincing, but when his case came to trial, the public attention was squarely on Silky. Devastating information came to light. An anonymous source informed the court that Silky was utilizing library resources without a library card… Silky became a pariah, a thief of public resources. With “the people” behind him, Mofongo laid judgment on Silky, giving him two options.
He could be drafted into the Queen’s war, accepting almost certain death. Or, he would be allowed to remain in the Woodlands, and his tongue would be cut from his mouth and chained around his neck, stripping him of his persuasive powers and signaling his untrustworthiness to all. 
Silky chose war with the hope of freedom in victory, retaining his powers in the hopes of avenging his parents once again.

Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Sybil.title: Sybil
Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Sybil.content:
Player: Liz (she/her)
Name: Sybil
Species: Tiefling
Class: Ranger - Swarmkeeper
Pronouns: She/her
Description:
Sybil has always lived a quiet life in the woods outside (the kingdom). She grew up admiring her father and his business. Their family had owned The Morrigan Weapon’s Shop for generations. Sybil, not being fond of hunting or killing, still found a way to appreciate the craft and beauty of the shop’s supplies. Occasionally her father would teach her lessons on how to hold a dagger or how to throw a knife. Her favorite has always been the longbow.
As the years past, Sybil grew away from the Morrigan. She was often found in local towns aiding with education projects and tutoring. She’d often be commissioned to create curriculums or essay prompts for local schools.
With the war going on in the kingdom, the Morrigan grew very busy. She tried to help her father whenever she could while balancing her other jobs and commissions. It wasn’t much longer from then that her father grew sick from being overworked. He passed away and left the Morrigan to Sybil, his only descendant.
For a long time, owning the weapon shop kept Sybil’s name out of the war draft. She was able to peacefully aid in the war she couldn’t care less about and make coin while doing so. 
On the day she was conscripted, Sybil’s heart dropped to the floor. She was able to choose her weapon, her fighting class, but no longer was she allowed to hide behind the business. 
She selected to be a Ranger since the longbow was always her best and favorite weapon. It also would keep her from close range melee—close range death. 
She was not looking forward to the bloodshed of war. She wished she could find a way out. Perhaps it was time for that particular wish to come true…

Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Лйнуст-Олав.title: Лйнуст Олави
Pages/Characters/Backgrounds/Лйнуст-Олав.content:
Player: Саша Sasha (she/her)
Name: Лйнуст Олави
Species:  Goliath
Class:  Ranger
Pronouns: (He/him)
Description:
7 feet 9 inches tall, warm toned light grey skin, sprinkled with freckles if you look close enough from long days working in sun-reflecting snow. Muscular in a way that makes it clear this bulk came from long hours doing manual labor. Biceps the size of a head. 
 -grew up in an extremely secluded mountain encampment that is difficult to reach for all except those who reside in the cold, rocky mountains that make up the terrain. Worked as a lumberjack along with ~70% of the population, but even among the people of the encampment was an outstanding worker due to his hulking size and skill. Could bet on where a tree would fall once cut down and would win. 
-the encampment never learned of the war due to its extreme seclusion, which is why Linust was never drafted in the first rounds. Only once the government started getting desperate and combing the outer reaches of the nation for stragglers and draft-dodgers were they informed of the war and brought in to serve. 
-the encampment never had a formal name, but the residents took to calling it The Boons. 
-due to his size and skill, the rest of the lumberjacks got used to calling Linust whenever a piece of machinery jammed, or a tree wouldn’t fall as it should. Linust would always come and help out, because he knew that no one else could, but secretly, he wondered what it would feel like to be small and have others help you all the time.

Pages/Mechanics/Gambling.title: Gambling
Pages/Mechanics/Gambling.content:
mechanics
Higher or lower
The dealer rolls 2d6 and announces the result. The players must guess if the next roll will be higher or lower than the roll on the table.
Yahtdee
All players roll 5d6, and can choose any number of them to keep or reroll. You each player gets two rerolls to build their final hand. The player with the best hand wins the pot.
Hand Rankings:

5 of a kind
large straight
4 of a kind
full house
small straight
3 of a kind
2 pair
pair
high die

2’s Ten
Each player rolls 2d10. In this game a 1 can equal 1 or 11. The goal is to get the closest to 21 without going over. After rolling the initial 2d10 you can choose to roll additional 1d10’s till you decide to hold or go over 21, resulting in a bust. You must beat the dealers roll to win.
Three’s Blind
The player rolls 3d4, and the house rolls 3d4, keeping the houses roll a secret. The player can then guess whether their roll is higher or lower than the dealers. If they are correct everyone rolls another d4, and guess again whether their new roll is higher or lower than the dealers roll. If they get this right, they win 2x their bet.

If the dealer rolled the same number as the player, they get to move on to the second round of guessing regardless of their guess.

Run Off
Each player rolls 1d6 at a time, and adds the roll to their total. Whoever gets the highest total wins. But if you roll a 1 you lose. You can keep rolling until you want to hold.

Pages/Plants/Marshes/Marshtail.title: Marshtail

Pages/Plants/Marshes/Purple-Dahlia.title: Purple Dahlia

Pages/Plants/Marshes/Willow-of-the-Marsh.title: Willow of the Marsh
Pages/Plants/Marshes/Willow-of-the-Marsh.content: A large willow tree, with ashy white leaves, that grows in the marshes. The leaves can be processed to enhance the magical properties of spells and potions.

Pages/Plants/Mountains/Moon-Lily.title: Moon Lily
Pages/Plants/Mountains/Moon-Lily.content: One of the most powerful magical plants, a remnant from the old world, originating from the sister planet, sometimes called the spirit flower. It is said that they exist half between the material world and spirit realm. They are extremely rare, and highly sought after. The moon lily is a blue-ish silver flower that grows in cooler environments. Typically high in the mountains at the edge of the tree line. Their petals are partially translucent with specs of silver and gold scattered throughout, the dark blue veins can be seen throughout the petal when inspected closely; in the moonlight these veins will pulse softly as they transport the sugars made from the moonlight. The Sepal are a frosty blue/white color. The Stamen filaments and Pistil are silver, while the Stamen Anther is golden brown. The Stems of the moon lily are a dark blue. Moon lilies are very sensitive to light, when in the bright sun for extended periods of time they will begin to shrivel, quickly losing their magical properties. While growing the Moon lily will fold into a bulb during the day to protect itself from the harsh sunlight, the Sepal enlarge and wrap around the flower to form this bulb. In the night, the lilies will emit a silver glow as they face the moon, slightly swaying to find the best angle to absorb the maximum amount of moonlight.

Pages/Plants/Mountains/Silvercone.title: Silvercone
Pages/Plants/Mountains/Silvercone.content: A large pine tree that grows in the mountains, it’s pinecones are used in ice magic.

Pages/Plants/Mountains/Thuja-Pine.title: Thuja Pine
Pages/Plants/Mountains/Thuja-Pine.content: A large pine tree with pure white needles and a dark black bark. The needles of the tree are used by mages for their ice and frost properties. Grows in the Gori Mountains.

Pages/Plants/Plains/Breeze-Grass.title: Breeze Grass
Pages/Plants/Plains/Breeze-Grass.content: A tall grass that grows in the plains. It emanates a gentle breeze from the base of the plant. It is used in air and wind magic.

Pages/Plants/Plains/Dragon-Lily.title: Dragon Lily
Pages/Plants/Plains/Dragon-Lily.content: A common flower in Jiadi used for basic fire magic. It has red petals that resemble fire and a dark green stem. Commonly found growing in the plains.

Pages/Plants/Plains/Giamelon.title: Giamelon
Pages/Plants/Plains/Giamelon.content:
plant

1cp for 6 seeds

Pages/Plants/Plains/Hypodaphine.title: Hypodaphine
Pages/Plants/Plains/Hypodaphine.content: A flower known for it’s psychedelic properties. It’s pollen is used for mind altering magic. Grows in the Northern plains of Jiadi.

Pages/Plants/Plains/Tiger-Snapdragon.title: Tiger Snapdragon
Pages/Plants/Plains/Tiger-Snapdragon.content: Tiger Snapdragons are bright orange or red, with black veins running down the petals. This flower is typically found in warmer climates, typically in Meadows or grassy plains. This flower is extremely resilient, growing on tall stalks, multiple flowers will spout off of a single stem. Studies done with the flowers reveal it has various health benefits When prepared correctly, however certain parts of the flower contain a strong poison. A defense mechanism by the plant to protect itself from large herbivores. Some research has also revealed the tiger snapdragon may have elemental properties. The most common Elemental properties involve fire, but some subspecies found in other climates may have other Elemental links. The tiger snapdragons found in more woodsy areas have a more brownish Orange appearance, and seem to be able to influence the stone and Earth around them. These Forest Tiger snapdragons are often found with large mounds of dirt and stone surrounding them at the base. When harvesting the Tiger Snapdragon, the flower is cut from the stalk, after which the petals are then carefully picked. The pollen is then separated from the petals with a soft brush.

Pages/Session-Notes/Session-1---A-New-Wo.title: Session 1 - A New World
Pages/Session-Notes/Session-1---A-New-Wo.content:
1/1/1305
Sent to the front lines of the war between Hawgthorne and Frille, the legion of soldiers you were once a part of have been almost entirely wiped out. Stuck under heavy spell and arrow fire, you are pinned down, unable to retreat. Suddenly a white flash filled the sky, and a rush of magical energy knocks you unconscious. After awaking scattered in the bushes near a path, it becomes clear that you are no longer in the midst of the war. The party discovered that they are in a new world called Ghibalia. The party met a hunting tribe, called Udine, lead by a fierce huntress, Tanya and her Fairy Dragon, Ajax. She tells the party that only hunters are welcome in the tribe. And that they can return in the morning to prove themselves on their hunt. Turned away from the tribe the party ventures to Giaspolt. The party see’s the small town preparing for The Seeding Festival. Each member of the party offered to do a small job in exchange for enough silver to pay for a room for the night. Rowan Sage ends up meeting Bastion Clearwater, the elder at the church. Recognizing a fellow person of faith, he and his fellow congregant invite Rowan to their church, Derevo. They explain that their are followers of Tresvani, the plant goddess. They discuss matters of faith with Rowan, offering her to join the congregation. While she refuses at first, Samyn still offers her to stay with them for the night. In her room she reads part of their holly scripture, and learns of The Divergence. In the morning, she joins the members of the church in the rejuvenation ceremony, where she feels a connection to nature and to the goddess. After feeling this connection, she is moved to join the church and become a Sister of the Forest. She is sent into the woods to find her connection to nature, where she finds a small blue mushroom that calls to her. As she is returning with the mushroom, she stumbles upon a clearing in the woods that was not their previously. A green shimmering mist fills the air where she can faintly see the face of who she assumes to be the goddess. After telling Samyn of these events, he tells her that she must have a strong connection to the goddess. She finishes her ceremony and officially becomes a member of Derevo, and a follower of Tresvani.
While this is taking place, Mars and Sybil head to Udine to prove themselves as hunters. Tanya tasks them with leading the hunt for the Hornax. After successfully felling the largest hornax of a small herd, they are celebrated and accepted into the tribe as the newest hunters of Udine. They are each given a horn from the hornax as trophies, as well as capes made from it’s pelt.
As a result of Frickcit, Candid, and Silky getting drunk and high, they end up missing the hunt and resort to finding odd jobs to occupy their day.
Frick and Candid end up meeting Arty & Jasper, two farmers that are heading to Greeb
to help excavate the new spawning chamber for the Greeb’s spawning season.
Silky tends the field with a group of farmers, earning significant coin in the process and becoming a trusted friend of Valbard, the owner of the Giastay Inn, after proving himself a hard worker. He is given the opportunity to tend bar, where he ends up hearing the troubles of  a traveling band. They request him to help recover a chest that was stolen from them by bandits. When Candid and Frick return to the inn, they offer to go with Silky to recover the stolen chest. As they begin to set out, Rowan finds them, and joins on their journey. They end up charming the bandits and recover the chest for Ashton.  During the reclaiming of the chest, Candid manages to get a peak at a set of bones in the chest.

Pages/Session-Notes/Session-2---Giant-In.filePath: Pages/Session Notes/Session 2 - Giant In The Woods.md
Pages/Session-Notes/Session-2---Giant-In.title: Session 2 - Giant In The Woods
Pages/Session-Notes/Session-2---Giant-In.content:
1/3/1305
Silky awoke to his genie, Genie, who informed Silky that he has been weakened after being severed from the primal sources of magic in the old world, Elysia. In order to return the genie to it’s full strength, Silky has been tasked to discover the primordial sources of magic in Ghibalia. Silky sought out his friends to relay this information and begin the search for the sources of magic in Ghibalia. Being led to Derevo by Rowan Sage, they are able to discover the existence of a shrine in Plyazh known as Jiejing. But the exact location of the shrine has been lost to time. Though they did find out that Valbard is originally from Plyazh, and might be able to give them some insight on where to start their search.
Meanwhile in Udine, a patrol group alerts Tanya to a strange giant in the woods. Sending Sybil to investigate, she discovers a goliath named Linust. After bringing him back to the tribe, he and Sybil are sent to hunt a pack of troublesome Sorridon.

Pages/Session-Notes/Session-3---The-Seed.filePath: Pages/Session Notes/Session 3 - The Seeding Festival Begins.md
Pages/Session-Notes/Session-3---The-Seed.title: Session 3 - The Seeding Festival Begins
Pages/Session-Notes/Session-3---The-Seed.content:
1/4/1305:
Rowan starts their day by finding flowers to give as an offering, where they yet again feel the presence of the Tresvani.
Mars discovered that magic in the world spread from specific primordial sources throughout the world. Having found a book discussing magical plants, they head out to find some plants to conduct their experiments. Finding some Dragon Lilies, they are able to focus their magical energy into the flowers, starting a small fire, discovering the Tinder Spell.  Later on, Mars seeks out Silky to further test their magical discoveries. Silky, having purchased a Legally Distinct Amethyst from a Greeb, is able to use the Dragon Lily to burn the coals Mars had procured earlier.
Waking up in the strange hunting village, Linust heads to Giaspolt to find where everyone has gone. Linust meets Frick and Candid, where they start to become acquainted. Linust talks about their people and asks about the family ties of Candid and Frick.
Frick talks to the traveling musician, Ashton, finding out their plans to travel to Plyazh for an upcoming concert. Frick asks Ashton what is in the chest they rescued for him, and he lies and says there is gold in the chest. Notably different from what he had said previously. Frick uses their invisibility to follow Ashton into their tent where they spy on his conversation where he says he will be rid of the chest by tomorrow.
1/5/1305
The Seeding Festival Begins! The ceremony starts with everyone dressing in robes, then gathering in the fields, where the druid Bryophi leads the ceremony, beginning the chant to summon the spirits of the land, infusing the land with their power. After spreading the seeds throughout the field the games begin!

A humanoid species of mushrooms that grow to be about 3’ tall, and emit a light blue bioluminescent glow.

Pages/Species/Orf.title: Orf
Pages/Species/Orf.content: Orfs are typically around 6’ tall, with skin green skin, and large tusks.

In a land ravaged by war, you have been taken from your homes. Untrained, poorly equipped, you have been sent to fight on the front lines of the war. I can’t wait to start this journey with you all! Send me anything you want put up on your page, your background, any art you’ve made for your character, whatever!
